title: "152 GENERIC EVILS"

lists.name: "152 GENERIC EVILS"
items: 1. Abuse [of alcohol, drugs, machines, opportunities, privileges, talents, one's body, knowledge, etc].
8. Bad, inadequate, or nonexistent exemplars or models.
21. Culturelessness, barbarism, or backwardness (e.g. of Third World).
26. Delusion, error, illusion, fantasy, blindness, or self-deception.
30. Discrepant values, cultures, weltanschauungen, customs, beliefs, etc.

notes: DEFINITION OF 'EVIL': Whatever is [bad, harmful, costly, destructive, negative, undesirable, wrong, or the like] -- to anything whatever -- in any way -- in any degree. The term may apply both to animate and inanimate phenomena, or to 'their point of view'. The concept is purely relative, except insofar as various integrals may be taken over all identifiable bads and these integrals may compete for the supreme degree of goodness.
